title: lobelia decurrens var. foliosa
intro: Lobelia decurrens var. foliosa, commonly known as "Foothill Lobelia," is a plant species belonging to the family Campanulaceae. It is a perennial herb native to the western United States, valued for its potential health benefits and medicinal properties. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia decurrens var. foliosa include its ability to aid in relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and act as a bronchodilator. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as lobeline and lobelanine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
